next.reason: 1985: "The EXTEND phrase must not be specified for a multiple file reel."; 2023: "The EXTEND phrase shall be specified only if the access mode ... is sequential and the LINAGE clause is not specified". The 2023 EXTEND restrictions (SR-14.9.27.3-2) cover only access mode and LINAGE. No candidate mentions multiple file reels, so the 1985 prohibition is no longer stated.
